payload.title: Default every OpenAI model to gpt-6-luna
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-02: all LLM calls use GPT 6 Luna. The stdlib web provider default (gpt-5.4-mini), the runtime, registry, procedure-config, IDE and evaluator fallbacks (gpt-4o), the stdlib generate/classify defaults (gpt-4o-mini), docs and spec examples all name gpt-6-luna. Adds Luna to the pricing table and the OpenAI known models, and treats gpt-6 models like the GPT-5 family (no default temperature).
